payload.title: the loop is slow
payload.body: Operator: units that should be straightforward execution take far too long. Observed per unit: planner 2 to 11 min, implementer 3 to 24 min, assayer 2 to 5 min, integrator 1 to 3 min; one unit end to end runs 15 to 35 min. Causes seen in the agents' returns: specs carry acceptance legs heavier than the change (cold reads on two models, live smokes, skill-size caps, verb-fidelity checks), so proving costs more than building; every hand-off is a cold start that re-reads its role, its composed skills, the design and the code; most roles run on the top tier with high reasoning (this host routes planner, assayer and, through task, integrator to opus high); the four hand-offs per unit run in series. Guards firing inside subagents may add judge waits to every tool call (inference; the ruling that guards bind main sessions only addresses it).
